13708364393.detail_text: The Best Cooling Solution for Singapore Nights Are you looking for a better night's sleep for your child? Our Bamboo kids pillowcase provides the perfect cooling surface for humid Singapore nights. We design every Hae Hae pillowcase with our signature 95% bamboo fabric. Consequently, your child stays comfortable and dry all night long. This breathable material naturally regulates temperature for a deeper, more restful sleep. Premium Quality in Every Bamboo Kids Pillowcase Since we own our manufacturing facility in Batam, our team oversees every detail. As a result, we ensure our Bamboo kids pillowcase stays incredibly soft and durable. Most parents choose bamboo because it wicks away moisture effectively. It also provides a soothing, frictionless surface for children with sensitive or delicate skin. Furthermore, our factory-direct model guarantees that you receive the highest quality materials directly from us. Safe and Gentle Bamboo Kids Pillowcase Standards Moreover, we maintain strict safety standards for every product we create. We use only OEKO-TEX® certified materials for your total peace of mind. Therefore, you can trust our bamboo bedding is free from harmful toxins and chemicals. We take great pride in every garment we produce for your family. Specifically, your child will love the buttery-soft feel of their favorite Hae Hae designs every single night. Key Benefits of Our Bamboo Pillowcases Maximum Cooling: Our Bamboo kids pillowcase uses fabric specifically engineered for humid climates. Skin Health: The hypoallergenic fibers prevent irritation for sensitive or eczema-prone skin. Perfect Fit: We design these cases to fit standard toddler and kids' pillows snugly. Batam Crafted: Our own factory carefully and thoughtfully crafts each piece to perfection. In conclusion, Singapore parents trust our premium bedding solutions. They offer the ideal balance of safety and comfort for growing children. Whether your little one is napping or sleeping through the night, we help them stay cool. Our Bamboo kids pillowcase is a must-have for a healthy and cozy nursery.

product.desc:
The Best Cooling Solution for Singapore Nights

Are you looking for a better night's sleep for your child? OurBamboo kids pillowcaseprovides the perfect cooling surface for humid Singapore nights. We design everyHae Haepillowcase with our signature 95% bamboo fabric. Consequently, your child stays comfortable and dry all night long. This breathable material naturally regulates temperature for a deeper, more restful sleep.

Premium Quality in Every Bamboo Kids Pillowcase

Since we own our manufacturing facility in Batam, our team oversees every detail. As a result, we ensure ourBamboo kids pillowcasestays incredibly soft and durable. Most parents choose bamboo because it wicks away moisture effectively. It also provides a soothing, frictionless surface for children with sensitive or delicate skin. Furthermore, our factory-direct model guarantees that you receive the highest quality materials directly from us.

Safe and Gentle Bamboo Kids Pillowcase Standards

Moreover, we maintain strict safety standards for every product we create. We use only OEKO-TEX® certified materials for your total peace of mind.Therefore, you can trust our bamboo bedding is free from harmful toxins and chemicals. We take great pride in every garment we produce for your family. Specifically, your child will love the buttery-soft feel of their favoriteHae Haedesigns every single night.

Key Benefits of Our Bamboo Pillowcases

  • Maximum Cooling:OurBamboo kids pillowcaseuses fabric specifically engineered for humid climates.

  • Skin Health:The hypoallergenic fibers prevent irritation for sensitive or eczema-prone skin.

  • Perfect Fit:We design these cases to fit standard toddler and kids' pillows snugly.

  • Batam Crafted:Our own factory carefully and thoughtfully crafts each piece to perfection.

In conclusion, Singapore parents trust our premium bedding solutions. They offer the ideal balance of safety and comfort for growing children. Whether your little one is napping or sleeping through the night, we help them stay cool. OurBamboo kids pillowcaseis a must-have for a healthy and cozy nursery.

2176662847.detail_text: Horgen introduces the new Bamboo Series , a 100% Bamboo Lyocell sheet that is soft, extremely silky and superbly cooling, perfect for Singapore's tropical climate. Unlike other versions of bamboo sheets that may be made with bamboo viscose, our bamboo sheets are 100% Bamboo Lyocell. Compared to Bamboo viscose, our Bamboo Lyocell features a superior hand feel, better draping characteristics, and more importantly, greater moisture absorbing properties. This collection of sheets will surprise you with its beautiful lustre, wonderful hand feel and ability to keep you cool throughout the night. Finished with simple stitching for a contemporary look, this range of sheets are available in several hues that have also been dyed using the reactive dye process, resulting in steadfast and long lasting colors. Photographs are for illustration purposes only. Individual home lighting temperatures can cause fabric colors to appear different in different lighting situations. As these are hand-sewn products, there might be a difference of +/- 5 % from the indicated size. While we strive to keep all sizes as accurate as possible, we seek your kind understanding should there be a slight difference in the actual product.

2716067456.title: Little Zebra Latex Pillow / Case for 2Y+ (4 Types)
2716067456.detail_text: Little Zebra Latex Pillows are designed to provide your kids with the most comfortable sleep while encouraging the natural alignment of the spine. Designed to enable blood circulation and relieve pressure on neck. Made with 100% natural latex that is naturally hypoallergenic it makes them dust-mite, mould and bacterial-resistant. Smile and say “bye” to sniffles, itching eyes and congestion! All pillow comes with 2 years warranty against manufacturing defect and a complimentary "2 Colors Stripe" design pillow cotton case! Additional pillowcases (sold separately) • Little Zebra & Fox Soft Bamboo Pillow Case • Drool Proof With Little Zebra latex products, you can be assured of the healthiest sleep of your life, now and for many years to come. Like all mothers, we know our families deserve the very best. Naturally hypoallergenic Great for babies or adults with allergies since our products are dust mite, mold and bacterial-resistant to ensure a healthy sleeping environment. - Smile and say"bye" to sniffles, itching eyes and congestion. Effective support All our products are designed with the human body in mind to ensure effective neck and spine support when you sleep Resilience and durable Our products are made from 100% natural, high-resilience Talalay latex with the highest manufacturing process. They will not sag or change shape for a long period of time. Our pillows have been tested to last more than 10 years. However, we recommend our customers to change their pillow every 2-3 years for hygiene reasons. Highly comfortable Soft yet firm, luxurious feel with 100% natural cotton casing help you fall asleep faster and go into persistent sleep for a longer period of time. Breathable Design 100% Natural Latex is a material with open cell. The material itself is breathable. Together with the design of the air holes matrix on the pillow and matt to enable maximum air flow to ensure you have a cool night sleep. Quality Material Highest quality 100% Talalay latex material used in all products FAQS: Can I wash or sun the pillows? Yes, you can wash our pillows and dry them in an airy area indoor. Please be careful NOT to dry your pillow under direct sun. Washing Instructions Step 1: Separate the casing and pillow Step 2: Place both casing and pillow into a laundry bag Step 3: Pop it in the washing machine Step 4: After washing, place in a ventilated place (under the fan is recommended). Please do not expose the natural latex pillow to heat/sun.

Our products are made from 100% natural, high-resilience Talalay latex with the highest manufacturing process. They will not sag or change shape for a long period of time. Our pillows have been tested to last more than 10 years. However, we recommend our customers to change their pillow every 2-3 years for hygiene reasons.

Highly comfortable

Soft yet firm, luxurious feel with 100% natural cotton casing help you fall asleep faster and go into persistent sleep for a longer period of time.

Breathable Design

100% Natural Latex is a material with open cell. The material itself is breathable. Together with the design of the air holes matrix on the pillow and matt to enable maximum air flow to ensure you have a cool night sleep.

Quality Material

Highest quality 100% Talalay latex material used in all products

FAQS:

Can I wash or sun the pillows?

Yes, you can wash our pillows and dry them in an airy area indoor. Please be careful NOT to dry your pillow under direct sun.

Washing Instructions

Step 1: Separate the casing and pillow

Step 2: Place both casing and pillow into a laundry bag

Step 3: Pop it in the washing machine

Step 4: After washing, place in a ventilated place (under the fan is recommended).

Please do not expose the natural latex pillow to heat/sun.

It supports natural spine alignment, relieves neck pressure, and promotes blood circulation for comfortable, restorative sleep.
Each pillow includes a free cotton casing with a 2-color stripe design, with additional soft bamboo or drool-proof bamboo jacquard cases sold separately.
The breathable latex with air hole matrix enhances airflow for a cool night's sleep.
Pillows are durable, maintaining shape for years, washable indoors, and recommended to replace every 2-3 years for hygiene.
Ideal for parents seeking natural, safe, and supportive pillows tailored to growing children.

1692003895.title: Weavve Signature TENCEL™ Pillow Case Pair [100% Tencel lyocell plain solid colour pillowcase Oeko-Tex®]
1692003895.detail_text: What it includes: 2 Pillow Cases Always flipping for the cold side? This pillowcase stays cool all night. You’ve found the coolest TENCEL™ pillowcases on the market! Made from 100% silky smooth TENCEL™ fibres, it’s naturally temperature regulating properties keeps your pillows staying cool through the night, no flipping required. We’ve updated our pillowcase design by swapping the overlap closure—now the longer panel overlaps the shorter one. It’s a small change, but it helps our pillowcases fit your pillows better. Every Signature Weavve TENCEL™ lyocell bed sheet is: Crafted from 100% Lenzing TENCEL™ Lyocell Fibres 400 single-ply thread count woven with the finest 80 yarn count threads Luxuriously soft sateen weave Oeko-Tex® Standard 100 certified: no harmful chemical finishes and toxic dyes used Eco-friendly and sustainably sourced Size: 51cm x 76cm Care Guide: Gentle machine wash in cold water at or below 30°C. Wash separately to avoid tugging from zips, buttons or embellishments from other fabrics. Iron on low heat if needed. Do not dry clean, do not soak. Flip sheets inside out to wash. Use of laundry bag is highly recommended. Line dry away from direct sunlight. Gentle detergent is advised, dilute concentrated detergents. Do not use any kind of bleaching agent or detergents with bleach as an Pilling due to abrasion is inevitable, we recommend using a razor blade to gently comb out the fuzz balls. * We’re thrilled to introduce a new and improved pillow case design - We have swapped the pillow case’s overlap closure around, so the longer panel overlaps the shorter panel. This change is minor, but we hope that it’ll allow our pillow cases to fit your pillows better. As we transition, some selected colours may still feature our classic design. Your order might include either the classic or new design based on the colour selected. Thank you for your understanding and support! Size Guide: Discover The Unique Qualities Of TENCEL™ The Coolest Material You Can Sleep On TENCEL™ stands out as an extremely breathable, temperature regulating and absorbent fabric. Lyocell fibres can wick excess moisture away quickly, keeping the body cool during sleep in a wide variety of climates. With our TENCEL™ bed linen, you can be sure to stay cool throughout and have less worries over night sweats disrupting your sleep. Exquisitely Soft, Gentle & Comforting Thanks to the natural structure of the lyocell fibre, TENCEL™ is most well known for how it feels - exceptionally luxurious and smooth on the skin. With a silky smooth hand feel, it’s more gentle than regular cotton and linen, thus making it beneficial for babies, and those with sensitive skin or allergies. As a naturally derived fibre, TENCEL™ is also hypoallergenic. Soft as a cloud, light and breezy - just the perfect environment for a peaceful night of sleep Stay Fresh All Day & Night No need to feel stressed about odour or bacteria ever again. TENCEL™ fibres have perfect moisture management which reduces bacteria proliferation without the need for any chemical additives. Furthermore, our TENCEL™ sheets are Oeko-Tex® certified, which means no harmful chemicals are used during the production process. Rest easy knowing that Weavve’s sheets are made from certified fabric that are kind to your skin and health. Authentic Fibres of Botanic Origins TENCEL™ lyocell is made from 100% sustainably sourced eucalyptus wood. The water and more than 99% of the chemicals used in the manufacturing process are recycled in a closed loop process. Not all TENCEL™ sheets are made the same - Our sheets are purely made with 100% TENCEL™ Lyocell fibres from Lenzing. Long fibres are also used when weaving the sheets resulting in a lighter, finer and more durable sheets. *** Responsibly Made At Weavve, we care. We care about how the decisions we make as a business can have an impact - from the people who help build our products, to the environment and all who share it, to the people we serve. We’re committed to the responsible sourcing, production, sale and use of our products. Before we ship any product, it undergoes several stages of quality checks. All products sold are brand new, please be assured that returned items will never be relisted or sold. Responsible Packaging At Weavve, we’ve made decisions in production and packaging that reduce the environmental footprint. We’re committed to low-waste, reusable packaging. Our boxes can be re-used as storage organisers.
1692003895.detail_html:
What it includes:

2 Pillow Cases

Always flipping for the cold side? This pillowcase stays cool all night.

You’ve found the coolest TENCEL™ pillowcases on the market! Made from 100% silky smooth TENCEL™ fibres, it’s naturally temperature regulating properties keeps your pillows staying cool through the night, no flipping required.

We’ve updated our pillowcase design by swapping the overlap closure—now the longer panel overlaps the shorter one. It’s a small change, but it helps our pillowcases fit your pillows better.

Every Signature Weavve TENCEL™ lyocell bed sheet is:

  • Crafted from 100% Lenzing TENCEL™ Lyocell Fibres
  • 400 single-ply thread count woven with the finest 80 yarn count threads
  • Luxuriously soft sateen weave
  • Oeko-Tex® Standard 100 certified: no harmful chemical finishes and toxic dyes used
  • Eco-friendly and sustainably sourced
  • Size: 51cm x 76cm

Care Guide:

  • Gentle machine wash in cold water at or below 30°C.
  • Wash separately to avoid tugging from zips, buttons or embellishments from other fabrics.
  • Iron on low heat if needed.
  • Do not dry clean, do not soak.
  • Flip sheets inside out to wash.
  • Use of laundry bag is highly recommended.
  • Line dry away from direct sunlight.
  • Gentle detergent is advised, dilute concentrated detergents.
  • Do not use any kind of bleaching agent or detergents with bleach as an Pilling due to abrasion is inevitable, we recommend using a razor blade to gently comb out the fuzz balls.

* We’re thrilled to introduce a new and improved pillow case design - We have swapped the pillow case’s overlap closure around, so the longer panel overlaps the shorter panel. This change is minor, but we hope that it’ll allow our pillow cases to fit your pillows better.

As we transition, some selected colours may still feature our classic design. Your order might include either the classic or new design based on the colour selected. Thank you for your understanding and support!

Size Guide:

Discover The Unique Qualities Of TENCEL™ The Coolest Material You Can Sleep On TENCEL™ stands out as an extremely breathable, temperature regulating and absorbent fabric. Lyocell fibres can wick excess moisture away quickly, keeping the body cool during sleep in a wide variety of climates. With our TENCEL™ bed linen, you can be sure to stay cool throughout and have less worries over night sweats disrupting your sleep.

Exquisitely Soft, Gentle & Comforting Thanks to the natural structure of the lyocell fibre, TENCEL™ is most well known for how it feels - exceptionally luxurious and smooth on the skin. With a silky smooth hand feel, it’s more gentle than regular cotton and linen, thus making it beneficial for babies, and those with sensitive skin or allergies. As a naturally derived fibre, TENCEL™ is also hypoallergenic. Soft as a cloud, light and breezy - just the perfect environment for a peaceful night of sleep

Stay Fresh All Day & Night No need to feel stressed about odour or bacteria ever again. TENCEL™ fibres have perfect moisture management which reduces bacteria proliferation without the need for any chemical additives. Furthermore, our TENCEL™ sheets are Oeko-Tex® certified, which means no harmful chemicals are used during the production process. Rest easy knowing that Weavve’s sheets are made from certified fabric that are kind to your skin and health.

Authentic Fibres of Botanic Origins TENCEL™ lyocell is made from 100% sustainably sourced eucalyptus wood. The water and more than 99% of the chemicals used in the manufacturing process are recycled in a closed loop process. Not all TENCEL™ sheets are made the same - Our sheets are purely made with 100% TENCEL™ Lyocell fibres from Lenzing. Long fibres are also used when weaving the sheets resulting in a lighter, finer and more durable sheets.

***

Responsibly Made

At Weavve, we care. We care about how the decisions we make as a business can have an impact - from the people who help build our products, to the environment and all who share it, to the people we serve. We’re committed to the responsible sourcing, production, sale and use of our products. Before we ship any product, it undergoes several stages of quality checks. All products sold are brand new, please be assured that returned items will never be relisted or sold.

Responsible Packaging

At Weavve, we’ve made decisions in production and packaging that reduce the environmental footprint. We’re committed to low-waste, reusable packaging. Our boxes can be re-used as storage organisers.

aiTexts: This Weavve Signature TENCEL™ Pillow Case Pair is crafted from 100% Lenzing TENCEL™ Lyocell fibres, featuring a 400 single-ply thread count with 80 yarn count threads for a luxuriously soft sateen weave.
Measuring 51cm x 76cm, the pillowcases have a 1/3 back envelope opening for easy fitting and secure pillow placement.
Oeko-Tex® Standard 100 certified, these eco-friendly pillowcases are free from harmful chemicals and toxic dyes, making them safe and gentle on sensitive skin.
TENCEL™ fabric offers excellent breathability, moisture-wicking, hypoallergenic qualities, and temperature regulation to keep you cool and comfortable.
Available in multiple colors and easy to care for with gentle machine washing, low heat ironing, and tumble drying options.
aiDescription.aiTip: AI-generated content for reference purposes only.

product.desc:
What it includes:

2 Pillow Cases

Always flipping for the cold side? This pillowcase stays cool all night.

You’ve found the coolest TENCEL™ pillowcases on the market! Made from 100% silky smooth TENCEL™ fibres, it’s naturally temperature regulating properties keeps your pillows staying cool through the night, no flipping required.

We’ve updated our pillowcase design by swapping the overlap closure—now the longer panel overlaps the shorter one. It’s a small change, but it helps our pillowcases fit your pillows better.

Every Signature Weavve TENCEL™ lyocell bed sheet is:

  • Crafted from 100% Lenzing TENCEL™ Lyocell Fibres
  • 400 single-ply thread count woven with the finest 80 yarn count threads
  • Luxuriously soft sateen weave
  • Oeko-Tex® Standard 100 certified: no harmful chemical finishes and toxic dyes used
  • Eco-friendly and sustainably sourced
  • Size: 51cm x 76cm

Care Guide:

  • Gentle machine wash in cold water at or below 30°C.
  • Wash separately to avoid tugging from zips, buttons or embellishments from other fabrics.
  • Iron on low heat if needed.
  • Do not dry clean, do not soak.
  • Flip sheets inside out to wash.
  • Use of laundry bag is highly recommended.
  • Line dry away from direct sunlight.
  • Gentle detergent is advised, dilute concentrated detergents.
  • Do not use any kind of bleaching agent or detergents with bleach as an Pilling due to abrasion is inevitable, we recommend using a razor blade to gently comb out the fuzz balls.

* We’re thrilled to introduce a new and improved pillow case design - We have swapped the pillow case’s overlap closure around, so the longer panel overlaps the shorter panel. This change is minor, but we hope that it’ll allow our pillow cases to fit your pillows better.

As we transition, some selected colours may still feature our classic design. Your order might include either the classic or new design based on the colour selected. Thank you for your understanding and support!

Size Guide:

Discover The Unique Qualities Of TENCEL™ The Coolest Material You Can Sleep On TENCEL™ stands out as an extremely breathable, temperature regulating and absorbent fabric. Lyocell fibres can wick excess moisture away quickly, keeping the body cool during sleep in a wide variety of climates. With our TENCEL™ bed linen, you can be sure to stay cool throughout and have less worries over night sweats disrupting your sleep.

Exquisitely Soft, Gentle & Comforting Thanks to the natural structure of the lyocell fibre, TENCEL™ is most well known for how it feels - exceptionally luxurious and smooth on the skin. With a silky smooth hand feel, it’s more gentle than regular cotton and linen, thus making it beneficial for babies, and those with sensitive skin or allergies. As a naturally derived fibre, TENCEL™ is also hypoallergenic. Soft as a cloud, light and breezy - just the perfect environment for a peaceful night of sleep

Stay Fresh All Day & Night No need to feel stressed about odour or bacteria ever again. TENCEL™ fibres have perfect moisture management which reduces bacteria proliferation without the need for any chemical additives. Furthermore, our TENCEL™ sheets are Oeko-Tex® certified, which means no harmful chemicals are used during the production process. Rest easy knowing that Weavve’s sheets are made from certified fabric that are kind to your skin and health.

Authentic Fibres of Botanic Origins TENCEL™ lyocell is made from 100% sustainably sourced eucalyptus wood. The water and more than 99% of the chemicals used in the manufacturing process are recycled in a closed loop process. Not all TENCEL™ sheets are made the same - Our sheets are purely made with 100% TENCEL™ Lyocell fibres from Lenzing. Long fibres are also used when weaving the sheets resulting in a lighter, finer and more durable sheets.

***

Responsibly Made

At Weavve, we care. We care about how the decisions we make as a business can have an impact - from the people who help build our products, to the environment and all who share it, to the people we serve. We’re committed to the responsible sourcing, production, sale and use of our products. Before we ship any product, it undergoes several stages of quality checks. All products sold are brand new, please be assured that returned items will never be relisted or sold.

Responsible Packaging

At Weavve, we’ve made decisions in production and packaging that reduce the environmental footprint. We’re committed to low-waste, reusable packaging. Our boxes can be re-used as storage organisers.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

EASVEN 1200TC Lyocell Pillow Case Pair Pillow includes a pair of pillow cases in the dust bag and uses 100% TENCEL™ branded Lyocell which is an eco-friendly fiber. Born from nature with a silky-soft texture and easy to take care (machine washable), biodegradable, gentle on skin, naturally smooth to the touch.

From forest to bedding, our 100% botanic origin TENCEL™ Lyocell sheets offer you long-lasting natural comfort for superb living environment.

HIGHLIGHTS

•100% Austria Lyocell Tencel

•Enhanced breathability

•Super soft and smooth

•Strong and durable

•Sustainable production

•Biodegradable

•Easy to take care, machine wash, lightweight and quick dry

•Great option for people with allergies as the fabric is unfavorable for bacterial growth and very gentle on skin

Colour options: Agate White, Tempered Grey, Pink Nectar, Moonlake Blue, Noble Grey, Pine Green, Rouge Almond

SIZE

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

•Machine wash on gentle cycle

•Do not bleach or soak

•Tumble dry at low speed. Alternatively, hang to dry is recommended

•Iron at low temperature if needed

•Do not use softener

2472901547.detail_text: Wake up refreshed and rejuvenated with the luxurious Beauty Silk Pillowcase Twin pack. A highlight feature of the Hotel Collection by Robinsons collection, the Hotelsilks Beauty Silk Pillowcases combine a silk front and pure cotton reverse for an amazing nights sleep. The wonderfully soft and smooth pure Mulberry silk against your face and hair is naturally hypoallergenic, containing anti-ageing amino acids that can replenish treated or damaged hair and skin - all whilst you sleep. The silk surface is gentle on hair, taming bed hair with the ultra-low friction of silk. The genius pure cotton reverse fabric holds the pillow and silk together so they stay in place throughout the night, ensuring a most restful slumber. Profile: 100% Mulberry silk (16 Momme, 6A grade) front 100% cotton (anti-slip) reverse Silky soft and smooth front Naturally hypoallergenic Reduces friction on skin and hair Cleverly designed cotton reverse to reduce pillow movement Gift box packaged Machine washable Oeko-Tex Standard 100 certified, toxic-free with no formaldehyde Includes: 2 x pillowcases Standard enveloped flap closure Size: 76cm L x 50cm W 3 YEAR WARRANTY Product Care: Hand or machine wash on delicate cycle. Do not tumble dry or dry clean. Cool iron.

Standard pillowcase (no sham): 50 x 75cm (2 pieces in a set) - fits most pillows

King pillowcase (with sham): 50 x 91cm + 5cm sham (2 pieces in a set) - fits king sized pillows - longer pillows than normal

Or

Bolstercase: 37 x 107cm (1 piece)

CARE GUIDE

Gentle machine wash using a netting

Line dry recommended

Tumble dry if necessary on a very low heat

Wash with baking soda/ vinegar for super soft sheets (optional)

---------------

OTHER KEY HIGHLIGHTS:

1) THE SOFTEST SHEETS IMAGINABLE

Made of 100% 300TC TENCEL™ Eucalyptus material, our sheets are like no other - perfectly smooth and silk-like, while still withstanding the test of time

2) Fits mattress heights from 15 - 43cm with 360 degree garters

Our sheets are made to fit most mattress heights up to 43cm. With thick garters, our sheets fit your mattress like a glove! No more loose sheets in the middle of the night

3) Certified free from harmful chemicals

7x silkier than cotton, 3x more breathable than silk

2929722379.title: KAPAS LIVING | Pillowcase (x2) or Bolstercase | 100% Extra-Long Staple Cotton | Standard & King Size
2929722379.detail_text: WHAT IS IN THE PACKAGE? - 2x pillowcases (20cm deep pocket, no sham for standard size / with sham for king size) OR - 1x bolstercase BRIEF DESCRIPTION - Made from soft, smooth 400TC extra-long staple cotton - Deep pockets (20cm) for a snug fit—even on thick pillows - Bolstercases come with easy-to-tie strings and has been fitted for most bolsters WHAT MAKES OUR PILLOWCASES & BOLSTERCASES SO GOOD? - Honest quality at fair prices - Breathable, soft and made to last - Thoughtfully designed for a better night’s sleep EXTRA-LONG COTTON FIBRES - Made from 100% natural cotton - 37mm extra-long staple fibres for stronger, finer yarns - More durable and breathable than regular cotton THREAD COUNT - 400TC is the sweet spot for soft, long-lasting sheets (comparable to 1600TC advertised by others) - Higher thread counts aren’t always better—they often use lower quality fibres - Our 400TC pillowcases feel like luxury without the markup OEKO-TEX® CERTIFIED - Free from harmful chemicals like formaldehyde - Safe for sensitive skin and everyday use SIZING OF PILLOWCASES - Standard Pillowcase (no sham) – 50cm x 75cm - King Pillowcase (with sham) – 50cm x 91cm Or - Bolstercase - 37 x 107cm CARE GUIDE - Gentle machine wash - Tumble dry on low heat - Optional: Wash with baking soda or vinegar to keep them super soft
2929722379.detail_html:
WHAT IS IN THE PACKAGE?

- 2x pillowcases (20cm deep pocket, no sham for standard size / with sham for king size) OR

- 1x bolstercase

BRIEF DESCRIPTION

- Made from soft, smooth 400TC extra-long staple cotton

- Deep pockets (20cm) for a snug fit—even on thick pillows

- Bolstercases come with easy-to-tie strings and has been fitted for most bolsters

WHAT MAKES OUR PILLOWCASES & BOLSTERCASES SO GOOD?

- Honest quality at fair prices

- Breathable, soft and made to last

- Thoughtfully designed for a better night’s sleep

EXTRA-LONG COTTON FIBRES

- Made from 100% natural cotton

- 37mm extra-long staple fibres for stronger, finer yarns

- More durable and breathable than regular cotton

THREAD COUNT

- 400TC is the sweet spot for soft, long-lasting sheets (comparable to 1600TC advertised by others)

- Higher thread counts aren’t always better—they often use lower quality fibres

- Our 400TC pillowcases feel like luxury without the markup

OEKO-TEX® CERTIFIED

- Free from harmful chemicals like formaldehyde

- Safe for sensitive skin and everyday use

SIZING OF PILLOWCASES

- Standard Pillowcase (no sham) – 50cm x 75cm

- King Pillowcase (with sham) – 50cm x 91cm

Or

- Bolstercase - 37 x 107cm

CARE GUIDE

- Gentle machine wash

- Tumble dry on low heat

- Optional: Wash with baking soda or vinegar to keep them super soft

product.desc:
WHAT IS IN THE PACKAGE?

- 2x pillowcases (20cm deep pocket, no sham for standard size / with sham for king size) OR

- 1x bolstercase

BRIEF DESCRIPTION

- Made from soft, smooth 400TC extra-long staple cotton

- Deep pockets (20cm) for a snug fit—even on thick pillows

- Bolstercases come with easy-to-tie strings and has been fitted for most bolsters

WHAT MAKES OUR PILLOWCASES & BOLSTERCASES SO GOOD?

- Honest quality at fair prices

- Breathable, soft and made to last

- Thoughtfully designed for a better night’s sleep

EXTRA-LONG COTTON FIBRES

- Made from 100% natural cotton

- 37mm extra-long staple fibres for stronger, finer yarns

- More durable and breathable than regular cotton

THREAD COUNT

- 400TC is the sweet spot for soft, long-lasting sheets (comparable to 1600TC advertised by others)

- Higher thread counts aren’t always better—they often use lower quality fibres

- Our 400TC pillowcases feel like luxury without the markup

OEKO-TEX® CERTIFIED

- Free from harmful chemicals like formaldehyde

- Safe for sensitive skin and everyday use

SIZING OF PILLOWCASES

- Standard Pillowcase (no sham) – 50cm x 75cm

- King Pillowcase (with sham) – 50cm x 91cm

Or

- Bolstercase - 37 x 107cm

CARE GUIDE

- Gentle machine wash

- Tumble dry on low heat

- Optional: Wash with baking soda or vinegar to keep them super soft

product.desc:
With over 20,000 sets sold online, our beloved Horgen Luxe Egyptian Cotton is now joined by the Luxe Deco Series. Crafted from the very same exceptional material, extra-fine 100% Egyptian Cotton Long Staple yarns, this new series delivers the same silky softness for a contemporary and minimalistic hotel look at home with a bold twist.

Offering a vibrant hues on our signature quality, the Deco Series is made from the same fabric as our best-selling Luxe Collection Barrett Hotel bedding. These sheets feature steadfast, long-lasting colors achieved through a reactive dye process and come in a range of rich colours to elevate your bedroom aesthetic.

🧵 100% Premium Egyptian Cotton Long Staple Yarn

Crafted from quality extra-long staple fibers, this material provides exceptional softness, durability, and a luxuriously smooth finish.

🤲 Silky Smooth Hand Feel

The finely woven fabric delivers an extra soft and crisp texture against the skin, offering the feeling of hotel-like luxury in your own home.

🎨 Luxurious & Bold Colours

Elevate your bedroom with a curated palette of rich, saturated hues designed to make a vibrant style statement and transform your sleeping space.

🌀Long-Lasting Reactive Dye Colours

Our advanced reactive dye process ensures colours remain steadfast and vibrant, resisting fading through countless washes to maintain their vibrancy.

💫Extremely Easy to Care For

Engineered for everyday luxury, the sheets are designed to be easily washed and dried with minimal effort, simply refer to the care instructions on the packaging.

📢📢IMPORTANT NOTE: This listing is only for a pair of Pillow Case.😊

✔️Egyptian Cotton Long Staple Yarn
